scientific_integrity.known_dependencies: classical Cauchy determinant formula, Laplace partial fractions and elementary convexity
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: all integer dimensions at least three, all positive leakage and budgets; strong- and weak-leakage limits
scientific_integrity.verification: complete analytic proof with a standalone exact-arithmetic spot-checker, not a formal infinite certificate

scientific_limitations: Only finite directed feedforward chains with common positive leakage, a single upstream input and a fixed sum of positive transmission rates are treated.
Uniqueness is proved for each limiting damping profile, not for all finite positive leakage values.
The determinant is a volume criterion, not a lower bound on the least Gramian eigenvalue or on robustness.
No independent mathematical validation or exhaustive publication-priority certification has occurred.
title: A sharp weak-damping budget concentration law for controllability volume on directed cascades
